No romance novel satisfies **all three** of the following conditions for the year 2023:

3. Appeared on the New York Times “Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction” list for **more than 20 consecutive weeks** in the same year.

# Bestselling Canadian books of 2023

January 8, 2024

[Research & Analysis]

At the end of last year, we showed you the [bestselling books of 2023]. Before we get too far into this year, let’s look at the bestselling books by Canadian contributors last year.

The following lists are based on print sales volume in Canada from January 1, 2023, to December 3, 2023, according to [SalesData], BookNet’s national sales tracking service for the Canadian English-language trade book market.

## [Top 10 bestselling Fiction books by Canadians in 2023]

[![Image 2: Covers of Meet Me at the Lake by Carley Fortune, Everyone Here Is Lying by Shari Lapena, and The Defector by Chris Hadfield]]

1. _Meet Me at the Lake_ by Carley Fortune🍁 (9780735243781)

2. _Everyone Here Is Lying_ by Shari Lapena🍁 (9780385698900)

3. _The Defector_ by Chris Hadfield🍁 (9781039005402)

4. _Five Little Indians_ by Michelle Good🍁 (9781443459181)

5. _A Death at the Party_ by Amy Stuart🍁 (9781668009109)

6. _The Whispers_ by Ashley Audrain🍁 (9780735239937)

7. _The Lie Maker_ by Linwood Barclay🍁 (9780063320598)

8. _The Drowning Woman_ by Robyn Harding🍁 (9781538756966)

9. _The Sleeping Car Porter_ by Suzette Mayr🍁 (9781552454589)

10. _Everything She Feared_ by Rick Mofina🍁 (9780778334378)

You can see all of these titles in this CataList catalogue: [Bestselling Titles in Canada in 2023 – Canadian Fiction].

This list is quite different from [last year’s top 10], with the exception of Michelle Good’s _Five Little Indians_, which was in the number one spot last year, and remains on this year’s list. Carley Fortune also returns to the list in 2023, but with a different book in 2023 than last year; in 2022, _Every Summer After_ was number two on the list.

Similar to last year, the majority of the books on this list, 80%, were frontlist — published in 2023. And there was one lone hardcover (Chris Hadfield’s _The Defector_) the rest were paperbacks.

## [Top 10 bestselling Non-Fiction books by Canadians in 2023]

8. _When the Body Says No_ by Gabor Maté🍁 (9780676973129)

9. _My Effin’ Life_ by Geddy Lee🍁 (9780063159419)

10. _Love, Pamela_ by Pamela Anderson🍁 (9780063226562)

You can see all of these titles in this CataList catalogue: [Bestselling Titles in Canada in 2023 – Canadian Non-Fiction].

There’s more overlap between the[2022] and 2023 Non-Fiction lists. Four books were repeats: _The Myth of Normal_ by Gabor Maté and Daniel Maté; _Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing_ by Matthew Perry; _12 Rules for Life_ by Jordan B. Peterson; and _When the Body Says No_ by Gabor Maté.

And on the flip side from the Fiction list above, there was only one paperback edition (_When the Body Says No_ by Gabor Maté) on the list, the remaining nine were all hardcovers.
